newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-RAIN LEAVES JONES STRANDED ON 99 NOT OUT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RAIN LEAVES JONES STRANDED ON 99 NOT OUT.

text.p: Rain robbed former Australian test batsman Dean Jones of a century and his side Derbyshire of an almost certain victory in the county championship on Saturday.
Jones and Chris Adams, who hit 108, put on 202 for the third wicket at Canterbury as Derbyshire moved towards an improbable victory target of 337 against Kent.
But with 89 needed and Jones one run short of his hundred the rain came to put an end to their chase.
The weather took a heavy toll on the first round of championship matches, none of the eight producing a victory.
